measurement: Whole-phone net battery-discharge estimate during observation of the final published CLI launch.
conversion: power_W = -current_µA * voltage_µV / 10^12; all observed discharge currents were negative.
aggregation: Arithmetic sample means, medians and extrema of the instantaneous current-times-voltage estimates; no energy integration or idle subtraction.

before_observed_cli_worker.interpretation: Other work was present. This is not a controlled idle baseline.

window_classification: The raw observer marked whether the CLI worker was running. Only these phase labels determine windows; process identities are excluded.
limitations: Includes host CPU, compiler, display, radios, background activity and accelerator. The pre-worker window includes other work; differences between windows cannot establish incremental inference or NPU-only power. These are single-run sampled phone power estimates, not calibrated isolated rail or sustained-generation measurements.
publication_scope: Aggregate numeric power statistics only. No samples, private paths, process IDs, weights or activations are published.
